message.content: {"action":"switch_architecture","reason":"All evaluated points meet the 60 dB SQNR requirement except the lowest-precision direct case, and the symmetric_preadd structure consistently gives much lower mapped area at equal precision (e.g., 8520 µm² vs 12783 µm² at coef_frac=15). Switching architecture has legal unvisited neighbors and is the best remaining way to reduce area while preserving numerical quality."}
